name: Ice Thistle Hills
summary: Ice Thistle yetis menace travelers southeast of Everlook. Snow covers the high hills, where a rugged cavern cuts through the slopes. The yetis claim the area and threaten anyone who leaves the main road.

sections.title: A Den of White Fur
sections.body: At the heart of Ice Thistle Hills, a great cave cuts deep into the rock. Ice Thistle yetis hunt and make their nests there, roaming the rocky slopes and winding tunnels. Their territory lies near Everlook, putting goblin trade and visiting prospectors at risk. So travelers and traders hire hunters to cull the beasts for their thick pelts and pristine horns.

faq.q: Where are the Ice Thistle Hills located?
faq.answer: Ice Thistle Hills lie in central Winterspring, directly southeast of Everlook, the goblin trading post.

aliases: what is in ice thistle hills
faq.answer: Ice Thistle yetis inhabit nearly all the hills’ slopes and the cavern. These white-furred brutes defend their territory fiercely.

faq.q: Why do adventurers hunt in the Ice Thistle Hills?
faq.answer: Travelers and tradesfolk in Everlook hire hunters to gather the yetis’ thick furs and pristine horns. These materials are prized for crafting and survival gear in the frigid valley.

faq.q: What resources can be gathered around the hills?
faq.answer: Icecaps grow on the outdoor slopes, and rich thorium veins lie deep within the yeti cave.

angles.text: The dark cavern burrowed into the hill is dangerous. Seasoned miners can find rich thorium veins there, guarded by yeti packs.
The freezing slopes around the hills are good ground for cold-weather plants such as Icecaps. Rare blooms sometimes grow near the cavern’s mouth.
